title: datawhalechina/deepagents-in-action builds production agents with LangChain and LangGraph
friendlyTitle: A Chinese course teaches how to build production AI agents
summary: Deep Agents in Action is an actively maintained Chinese-language course and repository for building production agents with LangChain and LangGraph. Recent work adds tested notebooks for grading rubrics and streaming, while the broader course covers context engineering, sandboxes and evaluation.
friendlySummary: This open repository teaches LangChain and LangGraph with lessons and tested notebooks. It covers topics such as context, sandboxes, streaming and checking agent results.
whyItMatters: Chinese-speaking developers can follow a structured route from basic concepts to runnable, tested agent workflows. The notebooks also provide concrete examples for teams comparing how LangGraph patterns behave outside simplified demos.
friendlyWhyItMatters: Chinese-speaking developers can learn step by step and run the examples themselves. Teams can also study the notebooks when designing their own agent workflows.
